name: cTnI Fast Test Kit
description: quantitative determination of Cardiac Troponin I (cTnI) in human serum, plasma or whole blood samples. This test is used as an aid in the diagnosis of myocardial injury such as Acute Myocardial Infarction (AMI), Unstable Angina, Acute Myocarditis and Acute Coronary Syndrome (ACS).
